name: trip_id
description: Surrogate key: MD5 hex of all canonical source columns. Unique after exact-duplicate removal.

name: vendor_id
description: TPEP provider code (TLC dictionary; historical codes 4/5 retained).

name: pickup_datetime
description: Meter engaged. NYC LOCAL WALL-CLOCK time carried in a UTC-labeled TIMESTAMP (source is timezone-naive). Recover with DATETIME(pickup_datetime, 'UTC'); never convert time zones.

name: dropoff_datetime
description: Meter disengaged. Same wall-clock convention as pickup_datetime.

name: passenger_count
description: Driver-entered passenger count. NULL when the source did not record it; never filled.

name: trip_distance
description: Taximeter distance in miles.

name: ratecode_id
description: Final rate code. Source NULLs mapped to 99 (TLC code for Null/unknown).

name: store_and_fwd_flag
description: Y/N; NULL when not recorded.

name: pu_location_id
description: TLC taxi zone where the meter was engaged (1-265).

name: do_location_id
description: TLC taxi zone where the meter was disengaged (1-265).

name: payment_type
description: Payment code (TLC dictionary; 0 = Flex Fare / unrecorded-attributes records).

name: fare_amount
description: Time-and-distance meter fare. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: extra
description: Miscellaneous extras and surcharges. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: mta_tax
description: MTA tax. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: tip_amount
description: Credit-card tips; cash tips not recorded. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: tolls_amount
description: Tolls. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: improvement_surcharge
description: Improvement surcharge. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: total_amount
description: Total charged to passenger, excluding cash tips. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: congestion_surcharge
description: NYS congestion surcharge. Source NULLs set to 0. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: airport_fee
description: LGA/JFK pickup fee. Source NULLs (incl. all pre-2021 files) set to 0. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: cbd_congestion_fee
description: MTA Congestion Relief Zone fee (from 2025-01-05). Set to 0 where the source has no such column. USD, exact decimal (Spark DECIMAL(10,2)).

name: source_month
description: First day of the TLC monthly file this row came from.

name: processed_at
description: When the Spark job that produced this row ran (true UTC).
